summary: Executed backend pytest regression (6 tests) and multi-role frontend E2E on public URL. Core API/UI workflows passed: health/auth, RBAC, dashboard filtering/export, document lifecycle with file validations, quiz create-review-approve-attempt-grade, notifications, and mobile navigation/overflow checks.

ui_bugs.issue: Console repeatedly logs warning: width(-1) and height(-1) should be greater than 0 during page transitions/responsive states.

action_items: Stabilize Recharts container sizing to eliminate width/height -1 warnings (likely hidden/transition render timing).
Keep this pytest suite as regression baseline for future iterations.
critical_code_review_comments: Performance risk: /api/quizzes loops per quiz and repeatedly queries employees/counts, causing N+1 DB query patterns at scale.
Maintainability risk: App.css is heavily minified into very long lines; future debugging/review effort is high.
test_credentials file has no concrete credentials entries; auth testing relied on demo-role flow only.
seed_data_creation: Created test entities via UI/API flows: TEST_UI_DOC_*, TEST_UI_QUIZ_*, TEST_DOC_*, TEST_QUIZ_*.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All major role flows were executed successfully on https://green-doc-app.preview.emergentagent.com using demo persona switching. Invalid upload and >10MB checks validated with /app/tests/assets/*.pdf. Essay grading path verified end-to-end. Remaining issue is repeated Recharts console warning about negative dimensions.
rca of the issue: Recharts warnings are reproducible across desktop/mobile and route/viewport changes. Likely root cause is ResponsiveContainer measuring before final layout size (hidden container, transition, or delayed mount). Mitigation: ensure parent chart containers have stable non-zero width/height before render, or gate chart render until container dimensions are known.
